en: YESTERDAY'S NUMBER-ONE P0 IS DONE: THE SITEMAP HAS BEEN RESUBMITTED AND GOOGLE HAS READ IT. GSC -> Sitemaps today shows Submitted 24 Aug 2026, Last read 24 Aug 2026, Status Success, and Discovered pages jumped from 16 to 86 - an exact match for the 86 <loc> entries on the origin. From Google's point of view, all 62 articles are NOW genuinely submitted. The entire value of the sitemap fix is no longer sitting idle.

The sitemap on the origin also ticked up: 86 URLs / 16,071 bytes (from 85 URLs / 15,883 bytes), carrying 62 article URLs (from 61) - one new article was added. The /articles hub links exactly 62 slugs, all returning HTTP 200 (HEAD-checked in three batches of 21/21/20), and the two sets match EXACTLY - nothing missing in either direction.

PERPLEXITY HAS CITED DXLIVING.COM FOR THE FIRST TIME. Ahrefs AI responses logs Perplexity at 1 response / 1 page - it had been 0 every previous scan. This is the first movement on the Presence dimension since tracking began on 28 Jul, taking platforms present from 2 of 6 to 3 of 6.

AI VISIBILITY 28 -> 30, THE HIGHEST SCORE RECORDED. Formula: (3+1+10+0+1)/5 x 10 = 30. The driver is Presence 2 -> 3 on the back of Perplexity. This is a different kind of gain from recent days: not a file being fixed on the origin, but a third-party AI system independently CHOOSING to cite the site. That said, it is one response and one page - treat it as a first data point, not a trend.

AI citations rose 19 -> 22. ChatGPT went 13 -> 15 responses and 4 -> 5 cited pages; Copilot held at 6 responses but its cited pages rose 3 -> 4; Perplexity entered at 1/1. AI Overviews, AI Mode and Gemini remain 0 - all three Google surfaces are still shut. Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

GSC 28 DAYS (26 Jul -> 22 Aug) WAS A QUIET DAY: clicks 68 -> 68 exactly flat, CTR 3.7% flat, impressions 1,849 -> 1,841 down slightly, query count 151 -> 149. Average position improved again 28.0 -> 27.9, the best reading recorded. The small falls are the rolling window shedding 25 Jul and picking up 22 Aug, not a traffic drop. Impressions were SUMMED BY HAND across all 28 rows of the DAYS tab; verified by the day-sum of clicks = 68, an exact match for the Total clicks tile.

THE MELBOURNE RENDERING CLUSTER IMPROVED FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE SCAN, in smaller steps than last time. '3d renders for builders melbourne' 12.8 -> 12.4 (the closest to page one ever recorded). '3d rendering melbourne' 22.1 -> 21.7. '3d renders for developers melbourne' 35.6 -> 33.3. '3d renders for property developers melbourne' 33.7 -> 33.3. EVERY Melbourne query on the board moved in the right direction. The Adelaide queries did not: 'best home builders adelaide' went 34.6 -> 34.7 on 105 impressions - still the biggest exposure on the board and still far too deep to convert.

Brand dependence held at exactly 80.9% for a second day: dxliving 35 clicks + dx living 20 clicks = 55 of 68. Across the ENTIRE 149-row query table, STILL exactly TWO queries have a non-zero click count - and both are brand. The remaining 13 clicks sit in Google's anonymised bucket.

GA4 28 DAYS (28 Jul -> 24 Aug): sessions 169 -> 251, events 874 -> 1,214, users 81 -> 144 (134 new, 18 returning), key events 2 -> 5. But engagement rate was essentially static 40.83% -> 40.64% and average engagement time fell 43s -> 32s.

But the quality is close to nil: a 27.16% engagement rate, TWO SECONDS of average engagement, and ZERO key events. By source: facebook / social 41 sessions (21.95% / 3s), m.facebook.com / referral 15 sessions (6.67% / 0s), facebook.com / referral 13 sessions (61.54% / 3s). Social is simultaneously the site's biggest volume story and its weakest quality story - worth checking what page social links actually point at.

The GA4 surge is explained by the 7-day check: 18-24 Aug alone accounts for 234 of the 251 sessions in the whole 28-day window (93%). That is both proof collection is healthy and a measure of how hollow the rest of the window still is because of the 29 Jul - 12 Aug outage.
